body:
Thanks @flyoung588 for the detailed testing and for validating the matrix across `AliasChoices`, `AliasPath`, and message types!

Regarding models combining custom initializers with defaulted aliases: I agree with your assessment that ad-hoc dictionary re-keying shouldn't be merged as a general solution, particularly given the boundary limitations on nested models and unions. Models with custom `__init__` that need to accept field names alongside aliases are generally expected in Pydantic v2 to specify `ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True)`.

The goal of this PR is to keep the serialization repair minimal and surgical for the core regression described in #9343 using standard `model_validate(..., by_name=True)`.

I'd prefer to keep #9352 focused on this clean baseline fix so maintainers have a simple, zero-risk patch to review once assigned. If maintainers feel custom initializers warrant broader reconstruction handling, that would be great to explore in a dedicated follow-up issue.
